description: List the fillable fields in a PDF form: name, type (text, checkbox, dropdown, radio, list), current value, choices and whether it is read-only. Call this before fill_pdf_form. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

file.description: The PDF form. Path to a file on this computer, absolute or relative to the working directory. Accepts: application/pdf.

name: list_pdf_form_fields
title: Fill PDF Form
